profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Duquesne Fund Services

positions.title: I.T. & Operations Manager
positions.description:
Skills Utilized: C#.Net, HTML5, CSS3, MS-SQL, PHP, Javascript, AJAX, MySQL, Windows Small Business Server 2011, Exchange, Active Directory, Adobe Professional CS3(Acrobat, Photoshop, Fireworks)
-- Designed and maintain law firm responsive mobile ready web presence (www.PaLegalServices.com) with MySQL data layer. 
-- Responsible for all IT initiatives including network design and administration, installation and maintenance of Windows server and desktop environment for law office.
-- Designed and maintain intranet client timesheet and billing application. Full suite enables employee entry of time worked on cases, invoice generation and electronic delivery, integration points with 3rd party accounting applications, and mobile optimized web application for monthly bill review procedures. The application’s business layer is written in C#, while the front end uses HTML5, CSS3 and Javascript. Billing and reporting rendered in PDF using Aspose PDF .Net component. 
-- Solely responsible for all accounting, payroll and tax preparation duties for firm.
-- Web marketing, social media management and search engine optimization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Skills Utilized: C#.Net, Perl, HTML, CSS, Javascript, AJAX, MS-SQL, Adobe Professional CS3, Unix
-- Full stack lead developer for proprietary Partnership Accounting application with web presentation layer, C# business layer, and MS-SQL data layer. Also developed customizations necessary to integrate with 3rd party applications such as Advent Geneva Fund Accounting and Eze Trade Operations Management software, 
-- Lead Developer for web based reporting application integrated with Microsoft Reporting Services.
-- Design and maintenance of all intranet applications.
-- SQL database design and maintenance. Created table structures, wrote custom stored procedures and used SQL Server Integration Services for data migration routines.
-- Worked with accounting department to automate preparation of tax forms using Adobe Acrobat, XmlPDF and Aspose PDF.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Skills Utilized: C#.Net, VB.Net, Visual Basic, ASP, Javascript, MS-SQL
-- Designed and developed custom CRM (customer relationship management) software.
-- Chiefly responsible for the design and development of all CTI (Computer Telephony Integration) software to integrate the company’s IVR and MPS applications with customer service applications.
-- Designed a complete system for monitoring, reporting and data mining customer service representatives’ call handling statistics. 
-- Responsible for web development for all online customer service applications.

positions.title: Lead System Analyst
positions.description:
Skills Utilized: HTML, VBA, Access, MS-SQL, Exchange, Windows 2000 Server
-- Designed, developed and maintained MS Access/SQL application to track ad sales, customer information, sales prospect information, work order completion and integrated this fully with the third party credit processing system while automating many credit processing tasks. 
-- Designed and developed the website, www.homeownersassociation.org. 
-- Managed a team of five developers.
-- Configured and maintained all SQL server procedures including table design, replication, DTS packages, stored procedures, security issues and backups.
-- Automated the company’s direct mail program with our sales database; Integrated SQL database with the United States Postal Service bulk mail software to reduce postage rates.
-- Designed and maintained 15-user NT network.  
-- Setup Virtual Private Networking using Microsoft’s Point-to-Point Tunneling Protocol

positions.title: PC Consultant III
positions.description:
Skills Utilized: Windows NT (workstation & server), HTML, Access
-- Designed databases for use in patient data collecting at the Rehab Hospital.
-- Fully responsible for the maintenance and design of Rehab Hospital intranet website, posting all project documentation, designing graphical site map, implementing search functions and organizing material.
-- Responsible for upgrading, maintaining and administering several third party applications.
-- Built and administered Windows servers. 
-- Responsible for daily support of over 300 users.

positions.title: System Support Consultant
positions.description:
Skills Utilized: Windows NT (workstation & server), Access
-- Created two MS Access databases (a help desk log to track calls and machine servicing information and a check registry) and maintained a third database. 
-- Installed and configured Windows desktop operating systems
-- Installed PC hardware components such as new hard drives, CD-Rom drives, floppy disk drives, Network boards, RAM chips, motherboards, sound cards, video cards, and power sources.

positions.title: Web Designer and Associate Editor
positions.description:
Skills Utilized: HTML
-- Designed, created and maintained two web-sites (www.transatlanticpub.com & www.businesstitles.com) 
-- Edited several new manuscripts for publication and collaborated on the authoring of a book with the publisher. Books edited include such titles as: Japan’s Hidden Face, by Toshihiko Abe; Tomorrow’s Global Community, by Jim Mann; Co-authored: The $25,000 Trivia Challenge with Ron Smolin.
-- Media planning and public relations. Worked with clients and sales representatives to promote new publications.
